# Friendly Tech Concierge

Friendly Tech Concierge provides patient in-home technology support in the Las Vegas Valley.

Website: https://friendlytechlv.com/
Phone/Text: (702) 570-9003
Email: help@friendlytechlv.com
Service area: Las Vegas, Summerlin, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Spring Valley, Enterprise, and nearby communities.

- In-home computer setup and troubleshooting
- Phone and tablet setup
- Printer setup and printer troubleshooting
